metric_name: Cumulative Penalties for Competition Violations Since 2010
metric_designer: Corporate Research Project of Good Jobs First

sources.name: Violation Tracker Global Summary: Top 500 Companies by Cumulative Penalties (2010 - April 2025):
sources.description:
This file shows the 500 publicly traded parent companies with the largest cumulative penalty totals in the period from 2010 through 30/04/2025. Along with the overall totals, the list shows a breakdown by our broad offense categories. 

The Violation Tracker Global is produced by the Corporate Research Project of Good Jobs First: https://violationtrackerglobal.goodjobsfirst.org/
